  Normalises any model output (HF dataclass, dict, tuple, plain tensor) to a
  (B,C,H,W) tensor with optional bilinear upsampling; unblocks all downstream
  transformer integration.

Phase 2 – HuggingFaceSegmentationWrapper (custom_models/huggingface_models.py)
  Loads any AutoModelForSemanticSegmentation from the Hub or a local path,
  bypasses the HF processor, and upsamples logits back to input resolution.

Phase 3 – TimmEncoderWithSMPDecoder (custom_models/timm_models.py)
  Combines a timm features_only backbone with SMP UNet/FPN/PAN decoders.
  Documents the zero-code SMP "tu-" prefix path as the recommended approach.

Phase 4 – TerraTorchSegmentationWrapper (custom_models/terratorch_models.py)
  Bridges TerraTorch foundation model encoders (Prithvi, Clay, SatMAE) with
  a linear or FPN segmentation head; handles single/multi-temporal inputs.

Phase 5 – LoRA / PEFT fine-tuning (fine_tuning/, config_definitions/)
  apply_fine_tuning_strategy() supports full / freeze_backbone / linear_probe
  / lora strategies; LoraAdapterConfig + FineTuningConfig dataclasses added;
  merge_lora_weights() for deployment.

Phase 6 – Hardened training loop (model_loader/model.py)
  _unpack_batch() replaces fragile batch.values() unpacking with configurable
  image_key/mask_key; set_encoder_trainable() made generic (no longer assumes
  .encoder attribute); _prepare_preds_for_metrics() guards metric calls.

Phase 7 – Inference pipeline (predict.py)
  Auto-merges LoRA adapter weights before inference; keep_lora_adapters flag
  allows skipping the merge for fine-tuning resumption.

Phase 8 – Example YAML configs (conf/examples/)
  smp_mit_b2.yaml, smp_tu_convnext.yaml, segformer_hf.yaml,
  segformer_lora.yaml, prithvi_terratorch.yaml, vit_linear_probe.yaml

Phase 9 – Unit tests (tests/)
  test_transformer_adapters, test_huggingface_models, test_timm_models,
  test_fine_tuning, test_model_training_step, test_terratorch_models,
  test_inference_pipeline – all offline, CPU-only, no weight downloads.

commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
Add option to bypass system proxy in plugin requests

The plugin's HTTP requests via the `requests` library were picking up
system proxy settings, causing 407 Proxy Authentication Required errors
in corporate environments.

Changes:
- Use requests.Session for all HTTP calls in APIClient
- Add _configure_proxy() that reads the 'ignore_proxy' setting
- When enabled (default), sets trust_env=False and clears proxies,
  making all requests connect directly to the server
- Add "Ignorar proxy do sistema" checkbox in Configurações dialog
  (checked by default) under a new "Configurações de Rede" group
- Saving settings immediately reconfigures the active session

Fix briefing load buttons missing on new briefing creation

Await _populateMapSelect() in _renderSlideEditor() so that the

rendering checks. Without await, the async map name fetch resolved
after the synchronous button checks, leaving slide.mapId as null

commits.author: Maj Diniz
commits.message:
Merge pull request #3 from 1cgeo/claude/fix-layer-addition-bug-QvUT8

fix: register CATALOG_ADD_LAYER listener eagerly in FeaturesTab const…

commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
fix: register CATALOG_ADD_LAYER listener eagerly in FeaturesTab constructor

The listener was registered in createUI() which only runs when the
camadas tab is first opened. Since the catalog modal emits the event
BEFORE calling expandSidebar('camadas'), the event was lost on the
very first catalog layer addition (no listener existed yet). On the
second attempt it worked because the first attempt's expandSidebar
had triggered createUI and registered the listener.

Moving the registration to the constructor ensures the listener is
always active as soon as FeaturesTab is instantiated during app init.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01CYJaJR2TwTLU82Hx4VGrS8

- Create uuid.js with generateUUID(), isValidUUID(), isLegacyId(), isValidId()

across devices, enabling future sync and collaboration features.

commits.author: Maj Diniz
commits.message:
fix(store): remove inverted dependency on tool_manager

- Remove direct import of resetColorCache from store.js
- Add ALL_DATA_CLEARED event to EventTypes
- Store now emits event when clearing all data
- Color picker helpers subscribe to event via initColorPickerEvents()
- Initialize event subscription in services.js during app boot

This fixes the architectural issue where store/ imported from tool_manager/,
which violated the dependency direction (store should be a leaf module).
